from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import hashlib,json,sys,subprocess,time
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/nml-sdv-recurring','/workspace/nml-sdv-recurring/tests']
from multisport_lab.integrity import IntegrityError,canonical,digest,stamp
from multisport_lab import sdv_production_common as common
from multisport_lab import sdv_production_store as stores
from multisport_lab import sdv_production_archive as archives
from multisport_lab import sdv_production_forecasts as forecasts
from multisport_lab.sdv_production_remote import ProductionGitCheckpointWriter
from test_sdv_production_archive import DraftTagMissingGitHub
from test_sdv_production_store import ProductionStoreTests


def need(ok,message):
 if not ok:raise IntegrityError(message)

class IsolatedClient(DraftTagMissingGitHub):
 def __init__(self,server=None):
  super().__init__()
  if server is None:self.clients=[]
  else:
   self.releases,self.assets,self.raw=server.releases,server.assets,server.raw
   self.clients=server.clients
  self.clients.append(self)
 def fresh_reader(self):
  reader=IsolatedClient(self)
  reader.write_budget_bytes=reader.write_budget_objects=0
  return reader

started=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat();tick=time.monotonic()
result={'schema_version':'nba-sdv-production-cache-checkpoint-integration-v1','evidence_lane':'SYNTHETIC_ONLY','started_at':started,'network_requests':0,'sports_source_requests':0,'remote_github_writes':0,'genuine_forecasts':0,'comparative_model_evaluation':False,'full_history_model_fit':False,'test_double':'API-shaped draft-by-tag-404 fake server; clients share server dictionaries only, never decoded API or wire caches. Three-atom invented law and tiny retained-history fixture.'}
case=ProductionStoreTests('test_independent_archive_restart_keeps_exact_originals_and_all14_categories')
try:
 case.setUp()
 fake=IsolatedClient();fake.write_budget_bytes=32*1024*1024;fake.write_budget_objects=64
 case.archive=fake;case.mode='DEVELOPMENT_ONLY';case.state=case.folder/'diagnostic-state'
 case.store=stores.ProductionStore(case.state,source_root=case.source,source_resolver=fake.recover_source,
  snapshot_resolver=lambda ref:fake.get_json(ref)['ledger_snapshot'],allow_diagnostics=True)
 tag='diagnostics-nml-nba-independent-cache-checkpoint'
 branch='diagnostics/sdv-production-load-20300101T000000'
 assets=case.fixture.assets()
 archive_refs=tuple(fake.retain_source(raw,meta,assets[4][role],tag=tag) for role,raw,meta in [('schedule',assets[0],assets[2]),('roster',assets[1],assets[3])])
 case.plan=case.fixture.build(assets,mode=case.mode)
 case.plan_ref=case.store.append_body(case.plan,archive_refs=archive_refs)
 case.input=case.fixture.fresh(case.plan,assets,mode=case.mode)
 case.input_ref=case.store.append_body(case.input,references=(case.plan_ref,),archive_refs=archive_refs)
 def git(*args,cwd):
  p=subprocess.run(['git',*args],cwd=cwd,capture_output=True,timeout=20)
  need(p.returncode==0,'Local synthetic Git command failed: '+args[0]);return p.stdout.decode().strip()
 git('init','--quiet','-b','main',cwd=case.source);git('add','.',cwd=case.source)
 git('-c','user.name=Independent Synthetic Review','-c','user.email=independent@example.invalid','commit','--quiet','-m','Invented tiny history fixture',cwd=case.source)
 base=git('rev-parse','HEAD',cwd=case.source);bare=case.folder/'synthetic-remote.git'
 git('init','--quiet','--bare',str(bare),cwd=case.folder);git('push',str(bare),'HEAD:refs/heads/main',cwd=case.source)
 def writer(name,archive):return ProductionGitCheckpointWriter(case.source,case.folder/name,base_commit=base,branch=branch,archive=archive,tag=tag,remote_url=bare,allow_local_test_remote=True,allow_diagnostics=True)
 def reject_public(*args,**kwargs):raise IntegrityError('Offline diagnostic must not perform public/network reads')
 checkpoints=[]
 with patch.object(archives.GitHubReleaseArchive,'_public_object',side_effect=reject_public):
  w=writer('first-writer',fake);w.prepare()
  checkpoints.append(w.checkpoint(case.store,(case.input_ref,)))
  case.intent=common.seal({'schema_version':common.INTENT_SCHEMA,'protocol_id':common.PROTOCOL_ID,
   'plan_id':case.plan['plan_id'],'cycle_id':case.input['cycle_id'],'mode':case.mode,'input_ref':case.input_ref.to_record(),
   'input_id':case.input['input_id'],'producer_binding_id':case.fixture.binding['binding_id'],'history_ref':case.history_ref.to_record(),
   'player_ids':case.input['shards'][0],'created_at':stamp(case.fixture.now)},'intent_id')
  case.intent_ref=case.store.append_body(case.intent,references=(case.input_ref,case.plan_ref))
  checkpoints.append(w.checkpoint(case.store,(case.intent_ref,)))
  with patch.object(forecasts,'_development_laws',side_effect=case.laws):bodies=case.pair()
  refs=[];originals={}
  for body in bodies:
   ref=case.append_forecast(body);refs.append(ref);originals[ref.record_id]=case.path(ref).read_bytes()
   checkpoints.append(w.checkpoint(case.store,(ref,)))
  original=case.store.snapshot_manifest();head=w._head
  need(all(case.store.admission(ref)['eligible'] is False for ref in refs),'Development fixture became eligible prospective research')
  need(all(case.store.read_body(ref)['issued_at'] is None for ref in refs),'Development fixture gained issue time')
  need(all(len(case.store.read_body(ref)['categories'])==14 for ref in refs),'Lost categories')
  root_reader=w.reader
  rid=fake.releases[tag]['id']
  need(root_reader._asset_cache[rid] is not fake.assets[rid],'Reader decoded cache aliases mutable server list')
  for i,client in enumerate(fake.clients):
   for other in fake.clients[i+1:]:
    need(client._asset_cache is not other._asset_cache and client._wire_cache is not other._wire_cache,'Independent clients share decoded/wire cache')
  restarted=writer('restarted-writer',fake.fresh_reader());restarted.prepare()
  recovered=stores.ProductionStore(case.folder/'restarted-state',source_root=case.source,allow_diagnostics=True)
  restarted.restore(recovered)
  need(recovered.snapshot_manifest()==original,'Exact snapshot differs on separate restart')
  for ref in refs:
   need((recovered.root/'records'/ref.kind/(ref.record_id+'.json')).read_bytes()==originals[ref.record_id],'Original numeric bytes changed')
  calls_before=sum('POST' in args for c in fake.clients for args in c.calls)
  object_count_before=len(fake.raw)
  retry=restarted.checkpoint(recovered,refs)
  need(restarted._head==head and recovered.snapshot_manifest()==original,'Idempotent restart changed original pointer/state')
  need(sum('POST' in args for c in fake.clients for args in c.calls)==calls_before and len(fake.raw)==object_count_before,'Idempotent restart mutated API-shaped archive')
  need(not (restarted.root/'.git/objects/info/alternates').exists(),'Separate restart shares Git alternates')
  need(all(not p['metadata_acknowledgment_recursive'] and p['original_records_recovered_at'] and p['proof_metadata_recovered_at'] for p in checkpoints),'Original/proof readback incomplete')
  result.update(status='PASS',models=[b['model_key'] for b in bodies],development_forecasts=len(refs),all14_categories=True,
   all_original_and_proof_readbacks_completed=True,checkpoints=len(checkpoints),separate_decoded_clients=len(fake.clients),
   original_bytes_unchanged=True,idempotent_restart_no_git_or_archive_mutation=True,git_objects_independent=True,
   snapshot_id=original['snapshot_id'],snapshot_records=original['records'],snapshot_bytes=original['bytes'],
   maximum_encoded_forecast_bytes=max(len(raw) for raw in originals.values()),
   archive_objects=len(fake.raw),archive_encoded_bytes=sum(len(v) for v in fake.raw.values()),
   tag_lookup_404_invented=True,public_network_path_called=False,record_hashes={rid:hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() for rid,raw in originals.items()},
   api_actions_by_client=[{'get':sum('POST' not in args for args in c.calls),'post':sum('POST' in args for args in c.calls)} for c in fake.clients])
except Exception as error:
 result.update(status='FAIL',error_type=type(error).__name__,error=str(error))
finally:
 case.doCleanups()
 result.update(completed_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),seconds=time.monotonic()-tick)
 outfile=Path('/tmp/nml-independent-cache-checkpoint-'+('optimized' if sys.flags.optimize else 'normal')+'.json')
 outfile.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
if result['status']!='PASS':raise SystemExit(1)
